//go:build integration

package validators

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestT104StudentHTMLActualHTTPProvider(t *testing.T) {
	address := os.Getenv("T104_HTML_PROVIDER_URL")
	if address == "" {
		t.Skip("requires the explicitly owned actual HTML HTTP provider")
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(address)
	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme != "http" || (parsed.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" && parsed.Hostname() != "localhost" && parsed.Hostname() != "::1") {
		t.Fatal("actual provider proof requires owned loopback HTTP origin")
	}
	client := NewFactory(nil, address, "", "", "", "", "").GetValidator("HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT")
	proof := map[string]any{
		"boundary":      "Student production Factory/HTML HTTP adapter → actual registered HTML provider/DI/filesystem simple-task rule fixture",
		"full_live_e2e": false, "live_html_engine_nats_transport_proven": false,
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if resultFile := os.Getenv("T104_RESULT_FILE"); resultFile != "" {
			data, err := json.MarshalIndent(proof, "", "  ")
			if err != nil || os.WriteFile(resultFile, append(data, '\n'), 0600) != nil {
				t.Error("could not persist Student actual HTML proof result")
			}
		}
	})
	positive := `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head></head><body><h1 class="title">Hello World!</h1></body></html>`
	negative := `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head></head><body><h1 class="title">Wrong</h1></body></html>`
	blankMessage, whitespaceMessage := "", " "
	cases := []struct {
		name, taskID, code string
		valid, technical   bool
		semanticCode       string
		semanticMessage    *string
	}{
		{"actual_positive", "simple-task", positive, true, false, "", nil},
		{"actual_learner_mismatch", "simple-task", negative, false, false, "", nil},
		{"actual_missing_rules", "t104-missing-rule-proof", positive, false, true, "", nil},
		{"actual_blank_authored_message", "blank-message", positive, false, false, "TAG_MISMATCH", &blankMessage},
		{"actual_whitespace_authored_message", "whitespace-message", positive, false, false, "TAG_MISMATCH", &whitespaceMessage},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		passed := t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			result, err := client.ValidateAll(ctx, tc.taskID, []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: tc.code}})
			item := map[string]any{"technical_error": err != nil, "valid": result != nil && result.Valid, "has_result": result != nil}
			if result != nil {
				item["semantic_error_count"] = len(result.Errors)
				if len(result.Errors) > 0 {
					item["semantic_code"] = result.Errors[0].Code
					item["semantic_message"] = result.Errors[0].Message
				}
			}
			proof[tc.name] = item
			if tc.technical {
				if err == nil || result != nil {
					t.Fatalf("missing actual rule fixture must be technical without learner result: result=%#v error=%v", result, err)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid != tc.valid || (!tc.valid && len(result.Errors) == 0) {
				t.Fatalf("actual provider semantic outcome valid=%t changed: result=%#v error=%v", tc.valid, result, err)
			}
			if tc.semanticMessage != nil && (result.Errors[0].Code != tc.semanticCode || result.Errors[0].Message != *tc.semanticMessage) {
				t.Fatalf("actual authored blank/whitespace message changed: %#v", result.Errors[0])
			}
		})
		proof[tc.name].(map[string]any)["asserted"] = passed
	}
}
